pages.text: Mine Arcane Crystals and put dark magic to work. Forbidden & Arcanus is T3's dark-magic mod, built around crafting with Arcane Crystals.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Arcane Crystals are a unique T3 crafting material, used in several cross-mod recipes. The mod's Runic Ritual system works alongside Occultism for advanced T3 magic crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Mundabitur Dust:$() A core ingredient of the T3 Archmage and Battlemage gear enhancement paths.
$(bold)Stellarite:$() A T4 material from Forbidden & Arcanus. Making it takes deep T3 investment, and several T4 endgame recipes use it.

$(bold)Where the reference lives:$() JEI tooltips and recipes cover the Forbidden & Arcanus mechanics, with every ritual input and crystal product listed.$(br2)$(bold)Next: set up an Arcane Crystal Obelisk$() and start generating Aureal.
